facts.fact: SudaHealth's own site describes it as a public-private initiative in partnership with the Ministry of Health of Khartoum State, whose platform integrates hospitals, clinics and laboratories through electronic medical record systems; the page is undated and the year is the document's published date, itself a proxy.

systems.owner: SudaHealth, a public-private initiative in partnership with the Ministry of Health, Khartoum State
systems.tiers: hospitals, clinics and laboratories, as the site puts it; no counts or places

note: An excerpt of a promotional home page, 68 words. The owner value is a reading of 'public-private initiative in partnership with' the state ministry: the initiative, not the ministry, is presented as running the platform. The site states no deployment figures, so no tiers or clinics fact is taken.
